summary: Genesis Healthcare Management, the management company for Kern Psychiatric Health and Wellness Center (Psychiatric Wellness Center) in Bakersfield, California, discovered unusual network activity on June 22, 2026. Specialists confirmed unauthorized access to files containing patient names, Social Security numbers, driver's license and government ID numbers, dates of birth, medical record numbers, Medicare/Medicaid IDs, diagnoses, treatment, prescription and lab information and insurance details. Kern Psychiatric reported to the California AG on August 21 and began notifying patients August 19, 2026.
